titolo: Zelensky's Record Drone Strike: 1,336 'Intercepted', Bridge Still Hit
angolo: Russia says it shot down a record 1,336 drones, yet the Kerch Bridge was still hit. Meanwhile Zelensky says Starshield speed limits are weakening Ukraine's own defenses.
descrizione: Zelensky's Record Drone Strike: 1,336 'Intercepted', Bridge Still Hit. Russia's Defense Ministry says it intercepted 1,336 Ukrainian drones overnight, the highest claimed number of the war, yet Russian officials confirm the Crimean Bridge was struck and traffic was halted. The Kremlin says the damage was 'insignificant'; Ukraine's General Staff did not acknowledge the bridge strike. Figures come from Russia's ministry and could not be independently verified. Subscribe: this story is still moving.

scene.testo: One night. Thirteen hundred and thirty-six drones. That is the number Russia's own Defense Ministry says it shot down. The figure could not be independently verified.
By Russia's own count, the most intercepts claimed since the full-scale invasion began. And Russian officials say the Crimean Bridge was still hit.
Crimea's Russian-installed governor, Sergei Aksyonov, confirmed the bridge had been struck.
How can a record number of claimed intercepts be reached, and a bridge still be struck? That is the question.

grafica.sotto: Russia's count could not be independently verified

scene.testo: Kerch matters. AP describes the Kerch Bridge as a key span for moving military and civilian supplies from Russia to Crimea. Moscow seized Crimea from Ukraine in 2014.
Kyiv Post counts it as the fourth time Ukraine has targeted the span since the full-scale invasion began.
About 600 drones approached the Moscow region, Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said. Six people were wounded in Krasnodar, local authorities said.
The Kremlin's answer? Spokesman Dmitry Peskov said the damage was minor.

But that's not the whole story. Satellite images posted by an open-source account and reported by TWZ show scorch marks and signs of damage on the road arch. The extent of the damage has not been independently confirmed.

visivo.testo: But that's not the whole story. Satellite images posted by an open-source account and reported by TWZ show scorch marks and signs of damage on the road arch. The extent of the damage has not been independently confirmed.

scene.testo: Road traffic was halted. The Russian outlet Mash reported about 2,000 vehicles were stuck. Crimean officials said a single lane had resumed by mid-evening, with traffic alternating directions.
Kyiv has not publicly detailed the bridge operation. Ukraine's General Staff said it struck the Ilsky refinery and an oil depot in the Azov area of the Rostov region.
A day earlier, Zelensky said Ukraine had neutralized more than 55 percent of Russia's oil refining capacity. That figure is his claim, citing a report by Major General Mykhailo Drapatyi.

citazione.testo: In total, we have already neutralized more than 55% of Russia's oil refining capacity

scene.testo: Kyiv says its strikes answer Russian attacks on its energy infrastructure. Zelensky said Russia launched over 2,300 attack drones and 1,590 glide bombs against Ukraine in the past week.

And Kyiv says Ukraine's own air defenses are weakened. A new speed limit on SpaceX's Starshield system, 161 kilometers per hour, restricts Ukraine's ability to shoot down Russian strike drones, Zelensky says.

What happens next? China has confirmed that Xi, Putin and Trump will meet in Shenzhen on Thursday, according to CNBC. Last week's US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi produced a prisoner-exchange agreement but no breakthrough on territory, AP reports.
A claimed record barrage. A bridge hit, with Russia calling the damage minor. And a war that shows no sign of slowing. Subscribe, because this story is still moving.
